decision.note: Val: raise the building if feasible, else best judgement. Feasible; it keeps level 6, the 24.3 m rise and the arrival film. #361 changes REFERENCE_HEIGHTS['625330785'] and the building's size[2] to 33.0, reference-blocks TOWER_TOP to 32.85 with one double-height frontage band (no 28.1 m line), adds a fourth checkpoint migration ahead of district-level-checkpoint-migration.js because the world fingerprint changes, and updates reference-facades.test.js. Deploying it migrates the production town checkpoint and needs its own authorization. Terrace: recommended setback at the tower's west end above the 10.6 m Le Colonial wing; the kit-to-building transform is #361's. Design record: docs/design/office-ipic/brief.md on #380.
